description: Label and group JavaScript ecosystem updates, keeping majors in their own PR, toolchain selectors out of the package group, and the engines floor out of the toolchain group

packageRules.description: Group non-major JavaScript updates into a single PR
volta and packageManager select the runtime and package manager this repo builds with, the same job mise does for every other tool. Group them so the selectors cannot disagree with each other
The same runtime pinned in .nvmrc, .node-version or .bun-version. Shares the toolchain group so it cannot drift from the volta and packageManager pins

engines is the oldest runtime a consumer of this package may install with, not the runtime this repo builds with. Grouping it with the selectors above would raise the published floor on every local toolchain bump. dependencyDashboardApproval keeps it visible without opening a PR on its own, because raising a published floor is a decision rather than a chore. Applications, whose engines nobody reads, can drop the approval gate. Keep this rule after the selector rules so the floor leaves their group
